mostWorthwhile.text: The B-cell development sequence was most worthwhile: the planned illustration separates antibody-secreting plasma cells from memory B cells and connects the immediate response to a later one.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final attachment of memory cells to the whole-body model felt mostly like assembly rather than a new biological interaction, though its explanation added a useful qualification.

surprise.text: I expected the dendritic cell and helper T cells to combine directly; compatibility feedback showed that their interaction required the lymph node and performed it automatically.

arbitrary.text: The lymph-node requirement was initially unclear, although the automatic combination made the location apparent. The description also does not explain how a displayed fragment is presented for T-cell recognition.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter offered similarly concrete connections between cell behavior and body-level effects, though the final assembly step was less engaging.
